title.en: Issue at premium and for consideration other than cash
title.kn: ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂನಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಗದು ಹೊರತಾದ ಪ್ರತಿಫಲಕ್ಕೆ ಷೇರು ವಿತರಣೆ

hook.en: A well-run company can ask more than face value for its shares. And sometimes it pays for a machine or building with shares instead of cash.
hook.kn: ಉತ್ತಮ ಕಂಪನಿ ತನ್ನ ಷೇರಿಗೆ ಮುಖಬೆಲೆಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕೇಳಬಹುದು. ಕೆಲವೊಮ್ಮೆ ಯಂತ್ರ ಅಥವಾ ಕಟ್ಟಡಕ್ಕೆ ನಗದಿನ ಬದಲು ಷೇರುಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Record issue of shares at a premium
State the uses of securities premium under Section 52

narration.en: A well-run company can ask more than face value for its shares. And sometimes it pays for a machine or building with shares instead of cash. Let us record both.
narration.kn: ಉತ್ತಮ ಕಂಪನಿ ತನ್ನ ಷೇರಿಗೆ ಮುಖಬೆಲೆಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕೇಳಬಹುದು. ಕೆಲವೊಮ್ಮೆ ಯಂತ್ರ ಅಥವಾ ಕಟ್ಟಡಕ್ಕೆ ನಗದಿನ ಬದಲು ಷೇರುಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ದಾಖಲಿಸೋಣ.

body.en: The excess of issue price over face value is credited to the Securities Premium Account, usually with the allotment money. Under Section 52 it may be used only to issue fully paid bonus shares, write off preliminary expenses, write off expenses, commission or discount on issue of securities, provide premium payable on redemption of preference shares or debentures, and buy back shares (Section 68). It cannot be used to pay dividends. Shares cannot be issued at a discount (Section 53) except sweat equity shares.
body.kn: ಮುಖಬೆಲೆಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಮೊತ್ತ ಸೆಕ್ಯುರಿಟೀಸ್ ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಜಮಾ. ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್ 52 ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಬೋನಸ್ ಷೇರು, ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಬರೆದು ತೆಗೆಯುವುದು, ವಿಮೋಚನೆಯ ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ, ಮರುಖರೀದಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬಳಕೆ; ಲಾಭಾಂಶಕ್ಕೆ ಬಳಸುವಂತಿಲ್ಲ. ರಿಯಾಯಿತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿತರಣೆ ನಿಷೇಧ (ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್ 53), ಸ್ವೆಟ್ ಈಕ್ವಿಟಿ ಹೊರತು.

title.en: On the board: Premium and vendor shares

narration.en: A share of one hundred rupees issued at ten per cent premium is priced at one hundred and ten.

say.en: A share of one hundred rupees issued at ten per cent premium is priced at one hundred and ten.
Machinery worth four lakh forty thousand is paid for in such shares. Divide by the issue price.
First record the purchase from the vendor.
Then pay the vendor in shares: four lakh to capital, forty thousand to securities premium.
Section 52 limits what securities premium can be used for. It can never pay a dividend.

body.en: When assets are bought and paid for in shares: Sundry Assets A/c Dr, To Vendor A/c; then Vendor A/c Dr, To Share Capital A/c (and To Securities Premium A/c if issued at a premium). Number of shares = purchase consideration ÷ issue price.
body.kn: ಆಸ್ತಿ ಖರೀದಿಸಿ ಷೇರುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾವತಿಸಿದಾಗ: ಆಸ್ತಿ ಖರ್ಚು, ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರನಿಗೆ ಜಮಾ; ನಂತರ ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರ ಖರ್ಚು, ಷೇರು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂಗೆ ಜಮಾ. ಷೇರುಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ = ಖರೀದಿ ಮೊತ್ತ ÷ ವಿತರಣಾ ಬೆಲೆ.

title.en: Try it: shares to a vendor

caption.en: Face value ₹100. Change the purchase consideration and the premium; the number of shares = consideration ÷ issue price.

narration.en: A higher premium means fewer shares are needed to pay the same price.

tryThis.en: Try ₹4,50,000 at a ₹25 premium: is the number of shares whole?
Set the premium to 0: what is the whole consideration credited to?

problem.en: Kaveri Ltd buys machinery for ₹4,40,000 from Ganga Traders and pays by issuing equity shares of ₹100 each at a premium of 10%. Find the number of shares and pass the entries.

steps.en: Machinery A/c Dr 4,40,000; To Ganga Traders 4,40,000.
Ganga Traders Dr 4,40,000; To Equity Share Capital A/c 4,00,000; To Securities Premium A/c 40,000.

answer.en: 4,000 shares; share capital ₹4,00,000 and securities premium ₹40,000

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. Kaveri Ltd buys machinery for ₹4,40,000 from Ganga Traders and pays by issuing equity shares of ₹100 each at a premium of 10%. Find the number of shares and pass the entries.
Class quiz. Discuss, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

points.en: Premium is credited to Securities Premium Account, not to Share Capital.
points.kn: ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ ಸೆಕ್ಯುರಿಟೀಸ್ ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ ಖಾತೆಗೆ, ಷೇರು ಬಂಡವಾಳಕ್ಕಲ್ಲ.

points.en: Section 52 lists the only permitted uses; dividends are not one of them.
Shares to vendors: number = purchase consideration ÷ issue price.
points.kn: ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರನಿಗೆ ಷೇರುಗಳು = ಖರೀದಿ ಮೊತ್ತ ÷ ವಿತರಣಾ ಬೆಲೆ.

homework.en: List five uses of securities premium under Section 52.

narration.en: Recap. Premium is credited to Securities Premium Account, not to Share Capital. Section 52 lists the only permitted uses; dividends are not one of them. Shares to vendors: number = purchase consideration ÷ issue price.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ ಸೆಕ್ಯುರಿಟೀಸ್ ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂ ಖಾತೆಗೆ, ಷೇರು ಬಂಡವಾಳಕ್ಕಲ್ಲ. ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್ 52 ಬಳಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪಟ್ಟಿಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ; ಲಾಭಾಂಶ ಅದರಲ್ಲಿಲ್ಲ. ಮಾರಾಟಗಾರನಿಗೆ ಷೇರುಗಳು = ಖರೀದಿ ಮೊತ್ತ ÷ ವಿತರಣಾ ಬೆಲೆ.
